changes: All Git calls disable lazy fetch, replacement objects, network protocols, hooks, inherited Git path/index/shallow redirection and global/system configuration.

Patch and bundle use separate bare repositories seeded independently; patch-created new objects cannot satisfy bundle bases.
Actual original shallow boundary commits reachable from the parent are retained. Missing unchanged parent data are disclosed; patch tree identity uses write-tree --missing-ok.
Missing required source-minus-parent OIDs abort explicitly. Every required new object must be supplied in the independently restored bundle pack.
Raw readback validates the packaged parent-isolation flags and identities while explicitly recording that remote readback does not execute the Git patch or bundle.
